text: Amazon, please oh please send out an email before shipment that allows you to pass on the toy if you’re not interested! (Like you do with subscribe and save items). The first two toys were great, the third one (maze builder) I honestly have no idea what the appeal of this toy would be or why my daughter would be interested in playing with it. And for some reason, it’s $7 to return it? I’m going to have to watch my order log like a hawk to cancel future toys we don’t want before they ship. We will see, but we might have to cancel.
label: neutral
